subject: Post-call: Deployment fit + Trial plan for Healthly AI
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle@healthly.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@healthly.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: deployment mode fit + proposed trial plan

Hi Kyle / Priya - thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can line up the right trial path. Please confirm any corrections.

Call summary (short):
- Use case: clinical triage assistant for patient intake (PHI contained in examples).
- Key constraints: must not persist PHI off-prem, audit logging required, need <100ms median token latency for interactive agent flows.
- Current preferences expressed: Healthly prefers control on data residency; leaned toward Private VPC but evaluating feasibility / lift.

Proposed trial goals (PoC / 4 weeks):
1) Validate inference correctness and latency on representative prompts (SLO: median inference latency <120ms for 512-token sessions).
2) Confirm secure networking and KMS integration for PHI (no unencrypted egress).
3) Measure cost delta between Private VPC and Dedicated capacity for 20k monthly active sessions.
4) Define handoff checklist for production: roll-forward plan and monitoring signals.

Options we discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput, isolated GPUs), Private VPC / on-prem (full control, extra integration work). Based on the PHI requirement, Private VPC is likely the right direction but we need to validate infra access and timeline.

Ask from you:
- Confirm that Private VPC is the preferred trial target (reply with yes/no and any non-negotiable technical blockers).
- Share the internal owner(s) we should coordinate with for networking and security (names + emails).
- Preferred week to kick off a 4-week PoC (we suggested Aug 23 start).

I attached a short POC-checklist and a one-page infra constraints summary to help accelerate.

Attachments: POC-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), Healthly-Infra-constraints.pdf (summary)

Next steps (from our side):
- If Private VPC confirmed, we'll schedule a 30-45m infra intake with our Platform Eng (Aditya) + Security (Ben) to walk network requirements and KMS options.
- If Dedicated is preferred, we'll scope resource sizing and a cost/throughput estimate and propose a test harness for synthetic load.

Thanks -
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Kyle Morgan <kyle@healthly.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@healthly.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: deployment mode fit + proposed trial plan

Ava - thanks for the clear summary. Short answers below.

1) Private VPC is our preferred path. PHI requirements and an upcoming SOC2 audit make any public-hosted persistence uncomfortable. We would consider Dedicated as a fallback only if private deployment timelines are prohibitive.
2) Internal owners: Priya Shah (CTO, priya@healthly.ai) and Mark Dunne (Lead Infra, mark.dunne@healthly.ai). Priya will own compliance sign-off; Mark will handle network/VPC peering and firewalls.
3) Aug 23 start works for us, but Mark will need 1 week to produce current VPC topology and a list of egress constraints (we can deliver by Aug 20).

Notes / blockers:
- Our infra team uses Okta SSO and AWS KMS; any KMS integration needs to be compatible or we need a clear wrapping plan.
- We won't allow outbound model telemetry that contains PHI; need explicit handling on Redwood side.

I'll loop Mark into the intake meeting once we confirm times.

- Kyle Morgan
COO, Healthly AI
kyle@healthly.ai

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle@healthly.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@healthly.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: deployment mode fit + proposed trial plan

Perfect - thanks Kyle and Priya. Internal note below so Aditya/Ben/Monica have context before the intake. Mark / Priya: feel free to forward to Mark directly; we've cc'd Redwood infra and security SMEs.

Internal context (for Aditya / Ben / Monica):
- Healthly prefers Private VPC. Key asks: KMS compatibility with AWS, no PHI in telemetry, audit logs accessible to Healthly, predictable token latency under typical agent load.
- Deliverables we need to produce before kickoff: network port & CIDR requirements, handshake for KMS integration, an initial infra runbook for the 4-week PoC, and a cost compare table for Dedicated vs Private VPC for the stated session volume.
- Timeline: Healthly to deliver VPC topology by Aug 20; target PoC start Aug 23. 4-week window.

Initial resource asks (Aditya): can you confirm availability week of Aug 23 for a 45m intake + 2 technical drop-in sessions during week 2? Also need a short list of items we'll require from Healthly (we'll capture below and in the shared Drive).

Monica - can you prepare a quick cost model (order-of-magnitude) comparing Dedicated vs Private VPC for 20k MAU agent flows? Ben - please flag any security gating items we should call out immediately (SOC2 artifacts, KMS patterns, allowed agents for telemetry).

I'll create the Atlassian ticket and a shared Drive folder and post links once we confirm times.

Thanks -
Ava

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Morgan <kyle@healthly.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@healthly.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: deployment mode fit + proposed trial plan

Thanks for the context. A few technical/security items I want to call out now so Healthly and our infra team can prepare:

Immediate gating items for Private VPC PoC:
- Network: required CIDR ranges and peering path; ensure no overlapping subnets. We'll need BGP/peering window and expected external IPs for egress rules.
- KMS: Redwood supports AWS KMS and can integrate via customer-managed keys. Need Mark's exact KMS ARN and whether cross-account key use is allowed.
- Telemetry: we will provide a PHI-safe telemetry toggle; by default we will disable any payload capture. Need confirmation that Healthly will not request full payload logs during PoC.
- Audit logs: we can surface per-request audit logs to Healthly (redacted for PHI by default). Healthly must confirm retention window required for audit.
- Certs & trust: if you want mutual TLS we'll need cert exchange and expiry policy.

Deliverables from Redwood before Aug 23 kickoff:
1) Network requirements doc (ports, CIDR ranges, routing caveats).
2) KMS integration patterns and a short runbook for key rotation.
3) PoC test plan that includes a latency/throughput harness, and an acceptance checklist matching Ava's success goals.

I'll slot time on Aug 24 for the intake and propose the following initial agenda: 1) network walk-through with Mark, 2) KMS mapping, 3) telemetry/audit expectations.

Ben Carter
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
